{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Do NOT remove -999 rows because the response rate does not depend on biomarker_baseline
print('Total rows before deduplication: {}'.format(len(df)))
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")
print('Total rows after deduplication: {}'.format(len(df_dedup)))

# Step 2: Compute response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_dedup.groupby("arm")["responded"].mean()

treatment_rate = response_by_arm["treatment"]
control_rate = response_by_arm["control"]
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print all required values
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Response rate in treatment arm: {treatment_rate}')
print(f'Response rate in control arm: {control_rate}')
print(f'Treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect}')"}
